subject: Unforeseen electrical field condition: existing conduit conflicting with the new duct

messages.text: We de-energized the circuit and logged the existing conduit conflicting with the new duct routing at Room 214 in today's field log; this isn't reflected in Electrical Detail 2/E502. This is routine and can be worked into the normal schedule. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This is holding up work in this area. A response within three days would be appreciated.

Keep the circuit locked out at Room 214 -- we'll send a revised routing sketch for the existing conduit conflicting with the new duct routing once engineering signs off. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.
Resubmitting after field verification: the existing conduit conflicting with the new duct routing at Room 214 is resolved per the attached sketch. A response within three days would be appreciated.
